items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: the tenor would have been Babe Rusin or Bud Freeman or Vico Muso and Arthur Rollini

ctx.x: And the trombones would be Red Ballard and Vernon Brown, the reeds would be Hymie Schertzer on alto and probably George Koenig: Bill DePew on third alto, the tenor would have been Babe Rusin or Bud Freeman or Vico Muso and Arthur Rollini, Adrian's younger brother. That would have been the real personnel. And of course, Stacey on the piano.
